about: Running shorts (running-shorts-textured.glb, RUGBYV 2026-11-23): coloured from the same garment split into parts by Tripo (running-shorts-parts.glb) by viewer/tripo-glbparts.mjs: the gathered waistband (tripo_part_56) the Waistband part, one smooth line at its foot; the hem bindings (tripo_part_11) the Hem part; the side panels (tripo_part_44) the Side panels part (a model split into pieces never gets the made shorts' own side panels: texture.js bare). Hem and side panels are listed as `sleeves` (each one piece with smoothed borders, sigma 3 cm; pastBody 1: the sleeves' 'past the body's side' rule off). Body and small bits the print. Inside: the cloth's own colour in shade.
